newsitem.title: USA: Entergy Miss. nuke seen on line Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Entergy Miss. nuke seen on line Sunday.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 1,173 megawatt (MW) Grand Gulf 1 nuclear power unit is expected to resume power production on Sunday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said in its Wednesday morning plant status report.
The unit, located in Port Gibson, Miss., was shut October 19 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
Separately, Entergy's 858 MW Arkansas 2 nuclear unit, shut Saturday for repairs to steam generator tubes, is expected to remain off line for about three weeks.
